title:
REX610 RELAY
INNOVATIVE SIMPLICITY
text:
With the world becoming more complex by the minute, sometimes the best answer is simplicity. In 2022, we launched the REX610 protection relay built exactly on that idea.

This plug-and-play, all-in-one device was designed to unlock all needed functions for basic power distribution protection today, while also being futureproofed for an evolving grid. A milestone of innovative simplicity, if we do say so ourselves.
funFact: Would you say that Chat GPT has made your life more simple or more complicated? We’ve all been figuring that question out together since 2022, which is when the tool launched to the public.

images.caption: REX610 featured a withdrawable plug-in unit for swift replacement, short meantime to repair, and minimized costly downtime.
REX610 offered smooth replacement of SPACOM with REX610 relays.
During the pandemic almost everything became virtual.  In May 2021, all lights were on the virtual launch of REX610.
